title: Workspace ONE to Intune — iOS/iPadOS Device Migration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (iOS/iPadOS re-enrollment from Workspace ONE incl. ABM/ADE re-assignment, supervised parity; wipe-and-re-enroll realities, live-device risk).
hook: Move iPhones and iPads from Workspace ONE to Intune — with Apple Business Manager done right
problem: Apple devices are the trickiest part of a Workspace ONE exit: supervised, ADE-enrolled iPhones and iPads must be re-assigned in Apple Business Manager and re-enrolled into Intune — often a wipe-and-re-enroll — with app and profile parity and minimal user disruption. This solution is the repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune iOS/iPadOS migration: ABM MDM-server re-assignment, Intune enrollment profiles, app/profile parity, and a ringed cutover with clear user comms.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Apple migration model, moving devices in Apple Business Manager from the Workspace ONE MDM server to Intune, supervised ADE re-enrollment (and the wipe-and-re-enroll reality), app/profile parity, and the ringed cutover.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Apple Business Manager + the Apple MDM Push (APNs) certificate and ADE token, Workspace ONE/ABM admin access, app/profile parity target, a pilot group, user comms) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: connect ABM to Intune, build Intune enrollment profiles, reassign devices in ABM, re-enroll (wipe where required) by ring, restore app/profile parity, validate, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — iOS migration-readiness discovery, per-device enrollment/supervision/parity validation, a migration status and app-parity report, safe remediation of stuck enrollments, and a migration-ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune iOS/iPadOS migration — Apple Business Manager MDM-server re-assignment, Intune enrollment profiles, app/profile parity, and a ringed cutover with clear user comms. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
